Welcome to your island! You get 6 turns a day. Press Play a turn to start your first one.
Each turn starts with a question from the sky pilot. When you've answered, press Next.
Every building makes coins each turn. Watch them pop, then press Next to build.
Last step! Press End turn and your island grows. Sky Races can wait until you've had a look around.

A rainbow! Rainbows bring sky crystals. Crystals raise buildings to level 3 and build the Sky Lighthouse.
Golden geese drop coins as they fly over. The weather in the sky is only ever good.
Lost travellers move in when there is room. More Houses make more room.
A warm breeze gives your boat extra speed in your next Sky Race. It lasts until you race.
Classmates can leave you gifts. You can leave them one too: open the Class sky and visit an island.
Win or lose, nobody loses anything in a Sky Race. Each right answer is a gust of wind for your boat.
Each stage makes the Sky Lighthouse taller. Build all 4 stages to light it!
